title: Freedom
theme: Pizza Day · freedom from brokey / stacking sats
description: Created while Robbie P was working on the Dread Pirate Robbie album, Freedom needed extra time to reach its final form. It features a rock loop from JD that inspired the lyrics, early production by Johnny Narotics, an initial mix by Spike Leo, new guitars recorded at FBT Studios in Detroit, and final production completed in El Salvador. Released as part of Robbie P's yearly Bitcoin Pizza Day series (May 22, 2026), the track follows the journey from coming up when money wasn't worth much, gambling on the come-up, stacking sats, and HODLing through momentum — while questioning whether true freedom from being "brokey" is real or just a mirage. Packed with raw bars about building vs destroying, trad wife goals, and staying solid on the path.
